data.narrative:
The ePlane Company is a Series B-stage autonomous drone manufacturer seeking a $40–50M raise. The relevant peer universe comprises eight private companies in the Drones & Autonomous sector, including Elroy Air, Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, and Joby Aviation; no public comparables exist in this narrow category.

A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints within the sector—only one same-stage peer was identified, below the three-company threshold needed for reliable triangulation. Accordingly, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Using the $14M total raised as a base proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the next funding round yields $26.6M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $31M, with a median of $27M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around the absence of narrow peer data; comparable company multiples on EBITDA, revenue, or users cannot be applied. Key risks to valuation include execution risk inherent to early-stage autonomous systems, regulatory clarity on drone operations, and the wide dispersion in maturity across the reference peer set. The $40–50M raise target implies post-money valuation likely in the $54–77M range, a 100–150% step-up from the midpoint estimate, warranting scrutiny of interim milestones and market traction.
